plugins.name: cloud
plugins.description: Lead, worker, reader, test author and retro skills for running batches of GitHub issues in Claude Code cloud sessions. Needs the github plugin from the same marketplace. No hooks.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: The pull-request skill: take a GitHub pull request from open to merged, from your own machine or from a Claude Code cloud session. No hooks; the local route calls read-only scripts shipped with the skill.

plugins.name: mise
plugins.description: Installs the tools a repository pins with mise when a session starts, and puts them on PATH. Runs a SessionStart hook: one script, which only installs what the repository's own mise.toml names.

plugins.name: humantray
plugins.description: A tray of things a session needs from a person: FYIs, choices, questions, to-dos and approvals, answered whenever the person chooses and delivered to the session that asked. Runs a hooks module (TypeScript) in every session where it is installed. Items are kept in the repository's git common directory (humantray/items.json) and never go into git; in a cloud session they are also copied to a private claude.ai page per repository (/humantray-page). The pane opens with /humantray-open; /humantray-viewer shows the repositories' pages in one pane on a computer that stays on.
